name: case_003_n_plus_one
description: PR introduces an N+1 query inside a request handler hot path. Reviewer should flag it as a performance / correctness issue and request changes.

pr.title: Return order line items in /orders response
pr.description: Embeds line items in the orders list response so the dashboard can render them without extra calls.

files.patch:
@@ -22,7 +22,22 @@ class OrdersHandler:
     async def list_orders(self, request):
         user_id = request.user.id
-        orders = await self.repo.list_orders_for_user(user_id)
+        orders = await self.repo.list_orders_for_user(user_id)
+        out = []
+        for o in orders:
+            # Fetch line items for each order
+            items = await self.repo.list_line_items(o.id)
+            out.append({
+                "id": o.id,
+                "total": o.total,
+                "items": [
+                    {"sku": it.sku, "qty": it.qty, "price": it.price}
+                    for it in items
+                ],
+            })
+        orders = out
         return {"orders": orders}
